summary: Nasus Pharma Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting the resignation of CEO Dan Teleman (effective July 22, 2026) and the appointment of Brendan P. O'Grady as CEO and Class III director, effective July 27, 2026. Teleman's departure was by mutual separation agreement, not due to any disagreement. O'Grady, a pharmaceutical industry veteran with prior roles at Assertio Holdings, Glenmark, and Teva, will lead strategic growth. His compensation is subject to shareholder approval. The filing also includes an updated corporate presentation. The board's prompt appointment suggests an orderly transition; watch for shareholder vote on O'Grady's compensation and any strategic shifts under new leadership.
